mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the uprights with the crossbar was the clearest construction milestone: the separate posts became a recognizable frame.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips felt repetitive in text because their resulting views were only subtly different.

surprise.text: The completed window showed a hand tilting a pinwheel, an unexpected motion for this assembly.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the lead followed the stated goal, but its route and purpose remained unclear from the result.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the frame was clear to build, but most decisions simply followed the sole offered action, and the final motion left me unsure how it related to the construction. Text alone cannot establish how recognizable the artwork is.
